title: Adaptive Inference-Time Scaling via Cyclic Diffusion Search
authors_zh: Gyubin Lee、Truong Nhat Nguyen Bao、Dongwoo Lee（KAIST）；Jaesik Yoon（KAIST、SAP）；Minsu Kim（Mila、KAIST）；Yoshua Bengio（Mila、蒙特利尔大学）；Sungjin Ahn（KAIST、NYU）
paper_type_zh: 自适应扩散推理扩展研究
best_for_zh: 研究自回归采样以外的测试时预算分配的读者。
one_line: ABCD uses cyclic diffusion search to adapt exploration depth and stopping time to the available inference budget.
ABCD 通过循环式双向扩散搜索，自适应决定探索深度和停止时间，从而按推理预算扩展计算。
why: It makes denoising depth and search termination explicit test-time scaling decisions.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly allocates inference computation through adaptive diffusion cycles, exploration, and stopping decisions.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Fixed diffusion schedules spend the same denoising effort on easy and hard inputs. They cannot decide whether another refinement cycle will discover a better solution or simply consume latency.

ABCD asks how diffusion inference can allocate computation per instance. Its target is an adaptive controller that can revisit a promising state, branch when uncertainty is useful, and stop when the expected return no longer justifies another cycle.

固定扩散日程会在简单和困难输入上花费相同的去噪努力，无法判断再进行一次细化循环会找到更好解，还是只会增加延迟。

ABCD 研究扩散推理如何按实例分配计算。它要构建的控制器能够回访有希望的状态，在不确定性值得探索时分支，并在预期回报不再抵消下一次循环成本时停止。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ABCD treats a diffusion trajectory as a search object, not a one-way sampler. Bi-directional cycles can send a candidate back to an earlier noisy state and refine it again, while an exploration–exploitation mechanism controls which candidates receive this extra budget.

Adaptive thinking time supplies the stopping decision. The key record is therefore the evolving diffusion state together with its branch and termination choices, rather than only the final decoded sample.

ABCD 把扩散轨迹视为搜索对象，而不是单向采样器。双向循环能够把候选送回较早的噪声状态再次细化，探索—利用机制则控制哪些候选获得这份额外预算。

自适应思考时间负责停止决定。因此关键记录是不断演化的扩散状态及其分支和终止选择，而不仅是最终解码样本。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method combines Cyclic Diffusion Search, automatic exploration–exploitation balancing, and adaptive thinking time. It alternates denoising with selective re-noising, retains or replicates promising particles, and terminates trajectories according to the available budget.

The authors evaluate the controller on diverse diffusion tasks and compare its efficiency with fixed schedules. The training consumer is the inference controller: it decides whether to deepen, broaden, or end search rather than changing model parameters at deployment.

该方法结合循环扩散搜索、自动探索—利用平衡和自适应思考时间。它在去噪与选择性再加噪之间交替，保留或复制有希望的粒子，并根据可用预算终止轨迹。

作者在多类扩散任务上评估控制器，并与固定日程比较效率。真正消费训练成果的是推理控制器：它决定加深、加宽还是结束搜索，而非在部署时修改模型参数。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The NeurIPS paper reports improved performance across its evaluated tasks while retaining computational efficiency. The evidence supports the narrower claim that adaptive cyclic control can beat an inflexible denoising schedule under comparable budget conditions.

It does not establish a universal rule for every diffusion model or objective. Gains depend on evaluation quality, the controller’s calibration, and the cost of revisiting states, so latency and output quality must be reported together.

NeurIPS 论文报告，该方法在所评测任务上提升性能，同时保持计算效率。证据支持一个较窄结论：在可比预算条件下，自适应循环控制可以超过僵硬的固定去噪日程。

它并未为每种扩散模型或目标建立普遍规律。收益取决于评测质量、控制器校准以及回访状态的成本，因此延迟和输出质量必须一同报告。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper turns diffusion depth into a live allocation decision. Rather than increasing every schedule uniformly, it combines backward cycles, branching, and a stopping policy so the same budget can be concentrated on uncertain candidates.

This makes the search trace an explicit artifact. A reproduction can inspect which state was revisited, why a particle received another cycle, and where the controller stopped spending compute.

论文把扩散深度变成实时资源分配决策。它不再统一延长每一条日程，而是结合回退循环、分支和停止策略，使同一预算能集中用于不确定的候选。

这让搜索轨迹成为明确工件。复现者可以检查哪个状态被回访、某个粒子为何获得额外循环，以及控制器在何处停止花费计算。

title: Limitations
局限
html: ABCD is sensitive to controller calibration, diffusion schedule choices, and the cost of cycling backward through noisy states. Its results concern diffusion inference rather than ordinary autoregressive reasoning, and applications should measure wall-clock latency, memory use, and failure cases before transferring the allocation policy to another model or task.
ABCD 对控制器校准、扩散日程选择和回退到噪声状态的成本敏感。其结果针对扩散推理而非普通自回归推理，应用前应测量墙钟延迟、内存使用和失败案例，再决定是否将分配策略迁移到另一模型或任务。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work to compare adaptive stopping and branching policies with fixed test-time schedules. It is a useful boundary case for Track10 because it shows that scalable inference need not mean longer text generation: the controlled resource can be denoising cycles and particle exploration.
可用这项工作比较自适应停止、分支策略与固定测试时日程。它是本方向的有用边界案例，因为可扩展推理不一定意味着生成更长文本；被控制的资源也可以是去噪循环和粒子探索。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the budget-matched baselines and stopping ablations before using the result as a general scaling law. Record cycle count, re-noising depth, branch count, evaluation signal, and wall-clock cost; these fields reveal whether an apparent gain comes from better allocation or simply more computation.
在把结果当作一般标度律前，应先阅读预算匹配的对照和停止消融。应记录循环数、再加噪深度、分支数、评价信号和墙钟成本；这些字段能判断表面提升来自更好的分配，还是仅仅来自更多计算。
